date.description: Only archive messages older than this date (e.g., '2024-01-01' or Perl Date::Parse format). Leave empty to disable date filter.

days.description: Only archive messages older than this many days (integer). Leave empty to disable age filter.

delete_immediately.description: If true, sync mailbox after every move — slower but improves crash recovery.

dry_run.description: If true, simulate archiving without modifying any mailbox.

mailboxes.description: List of input mailbox paths/URLs to archive (supports mbox, Maildir, MH via Mail::Box).

only_read.description: If true, only archive messages marked as read/seen.

output_box.description: Mailbox format for archived output, supporting Date::Format specifiers like %Y (year), %m (month), etc.

preserve_timestamp.description: If true, preserve atime/mtime of input mailbox files (applies to file-based formats only).

quiet.description: If true, suppress all output except errors. Ignored if verbose is true.

verbose.description: If true, emit informational messages. Overrides quiet mode.
